assumptions_and_limitations: Quantities and lengths were taken from the colored quantity legends printed on each sheet.
No panelboards, switchboards, distribution boards, breakers, or circuit schedules were legible on these three pages, so boards and circuits are returned empty.
Component placements are reported at sheet/floor level with null coordinates where sheet legends provide totals but individual symbol locations were not reliably enumerable at this image resolution.
Although an electrical symbol legend includes lighting fixture and dimmer symbols, no reliable fixture counts or dimmer counts were extractable from these page images alone.
Pages 4-6 are architectural reflected ceiling plans (A102, A104, A106), not dedicated electrical sheets.
Quantities were taken from the printed color takeoff/counts shown on each page and cross-checked visually where practical.

No switches, receptacles, panels, panelboards, switchboards, distribution boards, breakers, disconnects, fire alarm devices, sensors, junction boxes, or circuit schedules are legibly shown on these pages.
No board schedules or circuit rows are present on these pages, so boards and circuits are empty.
Cable/conduit entries are reported exactly as labeled in the printed takeoff text; route-specific placement and lengths by segment are not shown.

Most individual fixture coordinates were not enumerated because the request is limited to these pages and many repeated symbols are small; one placement per component type per page is provided with coordinates null when count is supported by the page legend/count.
The heading 'LIGHTING SCHEDULE' appears on page 5, but no readable schedule table content is legible in the provided image.
Page 7 is sheet A000 titled Civil Site Plan, not an electrical sheet.
Only site electrical-related items visibly labeled on this page were included.
No panelboards, switchboards, distribution boards, breakers, circuit schedules, wire sizes, conduit sizes, luminaires, switches, receptacles, or fire alarm devices are legible on this page.
Colored markup/keyed note at the lower left indicates counts of demolition items and was used as the basis for quantities.
Locations are approximate normalized coordinates derived from the visible image.
Cable lengths disagreed across drawings. The higher-confidence length was kept and the lengths were not added. Straight-line distances were not invented.
No embedded text found. The drawing may be scanned and will need OCR.
One or more pages have little or no embedded text and need visual analysis.
Electrical sheets were read in 3 focused requests so devices, quantities, and page locations could be extracted.
Legend symbols were captured with a focused Breeze AI vision pass because the page is a scan/screenshot or vector layout alone was incomplete.
Captured 31 legend symbol(s) from this drawing (vector layout and/or Breeze AI vision with glyph-column crops).
Printed labels, schedules, and scaled conduit segments were checked. No extra symbol counts, wire lengths, boards, or circuits were found beyond the model result.
